title: Optimizing Cross-Channel Retail Loyalty Campaigns
business: A mid-sized regional apparel retailer managing fragmented customer data across online and in-store touchpoints.
problem: Marketing analysts spend excessive time manually querying Real-Time CDP and Journey Optimizer to identify high-churn segments, leading to delayed campaign responses and missed opportunities for personalized re-engagement.
solution: The Adobe Marketing Agent connector enables analysts to use natural language within Claude to query customer segments and journey performance directly. By leveraging the connector's ability to interface with Real-Time CDP and Customer Journey Analytics, the team can instantly retrieve audience insights and trigger journey adjustments without navigating complex UI dashboards.
steps: Configure the Adobe Marketing Agent connector within the Claude Enterprise environment using the provided endpoint.
Set the active sandbox and dataview context to ensure the agent queries the correct production environment.
Submit natural language queries to identify specific audience segments showing declining engagement patterns.
Review the retrieved insights from Customer Journey Analytics to validate the segment composition.
Execute adjustments to the target audience list within Adobe Journey Optimizer via the agent interface.
outcome: Marketing teams achieve a more fluid workflow where data-driven segment identification and campaign refinement occur in a single conversational interface, significantly reducing the latency between insight discovery and action.
limitation: The agent relies on the accuracy of the underlying data views and sandbox configurations; if the dataview is misaligned, the agent may return irrelevant or stale insights. Users must verify the active context by checking the core-switch_sandbox_dataview tool output before executing critical campaign changes.
